news.headline: HDFC Bank Q2 results preview: PAT, NII may rise up to 9% YoY; deposit growth in focus
news.summary: HDFC Bank is set to unveil its Q2 results on October 17, 2026, showcasing key financial indicators. Analysts predict a year-on-year rise in net interest income of about 8%, driven by an increase in loans. Profit after tax forecasts vary among brokerages, reflecting a range of expectations regarding the bank's financial health.

news.headline: Persistent Systems shares slide 5% despite Q2 revenue growth. Buy, sell or hold?
news.summary: Persistent Systems shares fell 5% despite 7.8% sequential constant-currency revenue growth in Q2FY27, as margin contraction and a sharp decline in profit weighed on sentiment. Brokerages remained divided on the stock amid valuation concerns and acquisition-related costs.

news.headline: BoE's Bailey says energy price pass-through remains limited, rate risks persist
news.summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said rising energy prices have had limited broader inflationary effects so far, but warned that second-round pressures remain uncertain. With inflation at 3.1%, above the 2% target, policymakers are weighing potential interest rate hikes against economic resilience, rising borrowing costs and geopolitical uncertainty.

news.headline: US Market: Fed's Goolsbee says latest US inflation data is discouraging
news.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee called the latest US consumer and producer inflation data discouraging, raising concerns about persistent price pressures. While temporary factors such as tariffs and geopolitical conflicts could ease, he warned that demand driven by the rapid expansion of AI data centres could require a policy response.

news.headline: Persistent Systems among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
news.summary: Persistent Systems, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, Siemens Energy India, and Nestle India recorded futures open interest increases exceeding 11% on October 15, indicating heightened derivatives market activity.

news.headline: Will Ambani's all-fresh Jio sale prove to be a masterstroke for investors?
news.summary: Reliance Jio is set to roll out an ambitious Rs 30,213 crore IPO featuring solely new equity shares, not existing ones. In light of mixed results from recent Indian IPOs, this move aims to cut down Jio's debt while bolstering its financial standing. The company's IPO, valued at Rs 10.

news.headline: NSE, BSE, Groww, other capital market stocks rise up to 3% as Sebi revises CAS framework. What traders must know
news.summary: SEBI has revised the Closing Auction Session framework, changing market timings, order transfer rules and settlement price calculations for derivatives. The updated rules will take effect from December 7, 2026, with provisions for transferring unexecuted limit and iceberg orders kicking in on February 8, 2027.

news.headline: ICICI Bank Share Price Live Updates: ICICI Bank's Stock Movement Analysis
Indian Bank reports a Rs 1,388 crore gain from sale of NSE shares
news.summary: Indian Bank gained Rs 1,388 crore from the NSE listing, boosting second-quarter non-interest income by 50% to Rs 3,953 crore. The one-time gain offset pressure from rising bond yields, despite Rs 123 crore in mark-to-market losses. Meanwhile, Canara Bank and UCO Bank reported declines in other income, reflecting weaker treasury earnings.

news.headline: US Market: Fed Chair Warsh offers no signal on October interest-rate decision
news.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh gave no signal on whether the US central bank would change interest rates at its October 27-28 meeting, reiterating its commitment to price stability. Markets await further clues from economic data and policymakers on the rate outlook.

news.headline: New CAS rules decoded: What Sebi’s revised framework means for stock market traders
news.summary: Sebi has revised the Closing Auction Session (CAS) framework after receiving more than 20,000 comments from stakeholders. The updated rules introduce a 10-minute closing auction, restore the VWAP method for F&O expiry settlement prices and clarify order transfers. Most changes will take effect on December 7, 2026.

news.headline: Karur Vysya Bank shares rally 6% after Q2 profit jumps 37% YoY
news.summary: Karur Vysya Bank shares rose sharply after the private sector lender reported a 37% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 788 crore. Net interest income grew 19% to Rs 1,497.3 crore, while total business increased nearly 18% to Rs 2.40 lakh crore.

news.headline: Rupee rises 20 paise to 94.79 against US dollar in early trade
news.summary: The rupee reached 94.79 against the US dollar following structural forex interventions by the Reserve Bank of India. Elevated crude oil prices and declining equity markets limited the currency's gains. The dollar index decreased by 0.54 per cent, reflecting the dollar's weakened strength. While US retail sales exceeded forecasts, the Producer Price Index was unexpectedly high. Foreign Institutional Investors also offloaded significant equities on Thursday, impacting domestic market performance.

news.headline: Global Market: Japan's Nikkei rebounds after six-session losing streak; weekly loss nears 5%
news.summary: Japan’s Nikkei rebounded 1.75% after six consecutive sessions of losses, supported by bargain hunting and gains in technology and banking stocks. However, the index remained on track for a weekly decline as investors awaited corporate earnings and US midterm elections.

news.headline: HD Fire Protect IPO allotment likely today; GMP at 30%. Here's how to check status
news.summary: HD Fire Protect IPO allotment status is expected today following a massive 131.70 times subscription. The Rs 712.31-crore public issue commands a 30% grey market premium. Investors can check allotment status online via the registrar MUFG Intime India, BSE, and NSE websites ahead of its scheduled October 21 listing.
